knowledge_base.subject: Delivery problem
knowledge_base.sample_query: My {product_purchased} hasn't arrived and it's past the estimated delivery date.
knowledge_base.answer: We're sorry for the delay. Please check your order tracking link for the latest carrier update. If the package shows no movement for more than 3 business days, we'll issue a replacement or full refund — just confirm your order number and we'll process it right away.

knowledge_base.subject: Software bug
knowledge_base.sample_query: My {product_purchased} keeps freezing or crashing when I use a specific feature.
knowledge_base.answer: This is often fixed by updating to the latest firmware/app version, then restarting the device. If the issue persists after updating, try clearing the app's cache or performing a soft reset. Let us know your current software version if the problem continues.

knowledge_base.subject: Battery life
knowledge_base.sample_query: The battery on my {product_purchased} drains much faster than it used to.
knowledge_base.answer: Reduced battery life is usually caused by background processes or an aging battery. Try disabling unused features (Bluetooth, location, always-on display) and check for a firmware update. If the battery still degrades quickly after 30+ charge cycles, it may need to be serviced under warranty.

knowledge_base.subject: Product recommendation
knowledge_base.sample_query: I'm not sure which accessory or model works best with my {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: Happy to help you choose. Compatibility depends on your device's model number and intended use case — could you share those details? In the meantime, our officially certified accessories page lists everything guaranteed to work with your device.

knowledge_base.subject: Refund request
knowledge_base.sample_query: I'd like a refund for my {product_purchased} because it isn't working as expected.
knowledge_base.answer: We're sorry to hear that. Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase with proof of purchase. Please share your order number and reason for the return, and we'll send you a prepaid return label along with refund timing details.

knowledge_base.subject: Product setup
knowledge_base.sample_query: I can't get my {product_purchased} set up correctly out of the box.
knowledge_base.answer: Start by making sure the device is fully charged and running the latest firmware before setup. Follow the in-app or in-box quick start guide step by step — most setup failures happen when a step is skipped. Let us know exactly which step it fails on and we'll walk you through it.

knowledge_base.subject: Data loss
knowledge_base.sample_query: I lost important data or files stored on my {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: First, avoid using the device further to prevent overwriting recoverable data. Check if the device syncs to a cloud backup, since files are often recoverable from there. If not, we can advise on manufacturer-approved data recovery options.

knowledge_base.subject: Installation support
knowledge_base.sample_query: I'm having trouble installing software or drivers for my {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: Make sure you're downloading the installer directly from the official product page, not a third-party source. Disable antivirus temporarily during install if it's blocking the process, and confirm your operating system meets the minimum requirements listed on the product page.

knowledge_base.subject: Account access
knowledge_base.sample_query: I can't log into my account associated with my {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: Try the 'Forgot password' reset link first — most access issues are resolved this way. If you're not receiving the reset email, check your spam folder or confirm the email on file. If you're still locked out, we can manually verify your identity and restore access.

knowledge_base.subject: Peripheral compatibility
knowledge_base.sample_query: An accessory or peripheral won't connect properly to my {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: Confirm the accessory is listed as officially compatible with your device model. Re-pair the connection from scratch (unpair, restart both devices, then pair again), and make sure both devices are running current firmware, as compatibility issues are often resolved by updates.

knowledge_base.subject: Display issue
knowledge_base.sample_query: The screen on my {product_purchased} is flickering, discolored, or unresponsive.
knowledge_base.answer: Try a full restart first, as this resolves most temporary display glitches. If the issue persists, check for a pending firmware update. Persistent flickering or dead pixels after a restart usually indicates a hardware fault and may be covered under warranty.

knowledge_base.subject: Hardware issue
knowledge_base.sample_query: My {product_purchased} is making unusual noises or physically malfunctioning.
knowledge_base.answer: Please stop using the device if you notice unusual heat, noise, or smell, for safety. Confirm whether the issue happens consistently or intermittently, and let us know your purchase date — if it's within the warranty period, we'll arrange a repair or replacement.

knowledge_base.subject: Cancellation request
knowledge_base.sample_query: I want to cancel my order or subscription for {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: We can process that for you. If the order hasn't shipped yet, cancellation is immediate and free. If it has already shipped, you're welcome to refuse delivery or return it once received for a full refund under our standard return policy.

knowledge_base.subject: Payment issue
knowledge_base.sample_query: I was charged incorrectly or my payment failed for {product_purchased}.
knowledge_base.answer: Sorry for the trouble. Duplicate or incorrect charges are usually reversed automatically within 3-5 business days. If you don't see a correction by then, share the transaction ID and charge amount and we'll investigate and issue a manual refund if needed.

knowledge_base.subject: Network problem
knowledge_base.sample_query: My {product_purchased} won't connect to Wi-Fi or keeps losing connection.
knowledge_base.answer: Restart both the device and your router first. Make sure the device is within range and connected to a 2.4GHz network if it doesn't support 5GHz. If the connection still drops intermittently, try forgetting the network and reconnecting from scratch.

knowledge_base.subject: Product compatibility
knowledge_base.sample_query: I'm not sure if {product_purchased} works with my other devices or software.
knowledge_base.answer: Compatibility depends on your device's model and software version. Please share both, and we'll confirm whether it's supported or suggest a workaround. Our compatibility chart on the product support page also covers most common pairings.
